title: Current time display format
text: The system shall display the current time using hours, minutes, and seconds in a readable format.

title: Current time update rate
text: The system shall update the displayed time continuously so that the displayed value remains synchronized with the current time.

title: Display resolution
text: The system shall display the time with a resolution of one second or better.

title: Alarm settings display request
text: The system shall provide a user request action that displays the current alarm settings.

title: Alarm value presentation
text: The system shall display the alarm time in hours and minutes in a clear and readable format.

title: Alarm trigger condition
text: The system shall compare the current time against the configured alarm time and determine when the alarm condition is reached.

title: Alarm actuation
text: The system shall activate the buzzer when the current time matches the configured alarm time.

title: Alarm indication duration
text: The system shall sustain the alarm activation for an ALARM_DURATION of 1 minute to be clearly perceived by the user.

title: Manual time setting capability
text: The system shall provide a user interface mechanism to set the current time.

title: Manual alarm setting capability
text: The system shall provide a user interface mechanism to set the alarm time.

title: User input validation
text: The system shall validate user-entered time and alarm values to ensure they are within valid ranges.

title: Power supply continuity
text: The system shall be powered by an internal source capable of supporting continuous operation without interruption for up to 60 days.

title: Power autonomy margin
text: The system shall maintain functionality throughout the required operating duration without requiring a power interruption or recharge cycle.

title: Display readability distance
text: The system shall allow the display to be read from at least 3 meters under normal lighting conditions.

title: Display contrast and visibility
text: The display shall provide sufficient contrast and luminance to remain readable in normal lighting conditions at the specified viewing distance.

title: Viewing angle requirement
text: The system shall maintain display readability over an angular range of at least 45 degrees from the nominal viewing direction.

title: Display visibility in all directions
text: The system shall be designed to keep the display legible when viewed from all directions within the specified 45-degree angular requirement.

title: Buzzer sound level
text: The system shall generate an alarm sound level of at least 70 dB measured at a distance of 1 meter.

title: Buzzer sound output repeatability
text: The system shall generate an alarm sound level of 70 dB ± 3 dB measured at a distance of 1 meter from the buzzer for each activation, with a maximum variation of 3 dB between 10 consecutive alarm activations during normal operation.

title: Impact resistance
text: The system shall withstand a drop from 1 meter onto a hard surface without damage to the display or buzzer.

title: Impact integrity
text: The system shall preserve the functionality of the display and alarm buzzer after the specified drop test.

title: Temperature operating range
text: The system shall operate without damage across a temperature range from -10°C to 50°C.

title: Temperature recovery behavior
text: The system shall recover normal operation after exposure to the specified minimum and maximum operating temperatures without permanent damage.

title: Humidity operating range
text: The system shall operate without damage across a humidity range from 10% to 90%.

title: Humidity resilience
text: The system shall maintain its functionality and structural integrity after exposure to the specified humidity range.

title: Stability on a flat surface
text: The system shall remain stable on a flat surface during normal operation.

title: Display inclination tolerance
text: The system shall maintain the display angle within 30° ± 2° relative to the horizon when placed on a flat surface.

title: Safe default initialization
text: The system shall initialize into a safe default state after power-up, including a valid time reference and no active alarm until the user configures an alarm.

title: Snooze button and delay function
text: The system shall provide a dedicated snooze button that, when pressed during an active alarm, triggers a software function to delay the alarm for a specified snooze duration without requiring a full alarm reset.
